### geomycin-identity: Geomycin source sense remains unresolved

major / open / confirmed; issue key: waris-dissolve-source.

## Limits And Additional Notes

- Completed means all assigned cases were scientifically assessed and independently challenged, including explicit unresolved dispositions; it does not mean every source identity is resolved.
- Primary searches are bounded; failed requests and unsuccessful exact-name queries are retained and do not prove an ontology term or chemical form cannot exist.
- Existing unrelated record roles, aliases, occurrence statistics and complete exported payloads are not recertified by a source-specific positive alias decision.
- Shared evidence cache captures retain original bytes/timestamps and confer no source-case, owner or export approval.
- No maintained-source curation, synchronization, downstream rebuild, merge, paid research or additional external session occurred.
- First-round materials proposal bytes were overwritten before the skeptic copied them; observed original hashes and findings are retained, and subsequent/final exact inputs were copied and re-reviewed.

- assessment_id: case-001
  area: identity
  topic: Source-specific identity, supplied form and preparation boundary
  outcome: supported
  summary: Na3-NTA states three sodium counterions, and TOGO M2562 uses it as a weighed
    component. ChEBI132766 explicitly defines sodium:nitrilotriacetate 3:1. This supports
    the unqualified trisodium-salt name; it does not identify the separate monohydrate
    stock in MediaDive1482.
  target_ids:

- assessment_id: case-002
  area: identity
  topic: Source-specific identity, supplied form and preparation boundary
  outcome: supported
  summary: 'The source names ordinary BD/Difco/Bacto Casamino acid casein acid hydrolysate,
    with spelling/case/catalog-family qualifiers but no vitamin-depletion or concentration
    qualifier. Thermo primary guide distinguishes this amino-acid/peptide mixture
    from pancreatic tryptone and vitamin-assay material. Propose source-label additions
    to the ordinary owner; its shared FOODON parent must not collapse Casein peptone,
    and inherited carbocerate/metadata aliases need retirement before any whole-row
    release. No new CAS or molecular structure is inferred. The inherited Casamino
    Acids(0.01% fragment remains RAW_TEXT: prior#213 identified it as a truncated
    dose annotation, and this review lacks claim-specific evidence to reject it or
    reclassify it as a stock. Whole-row export review remains held. Independent review
    prompted exact ontology search: official active MeSH C017721 defines this acid
    hydrolysate, so the after proposal uses that exact material identity instead of
    registry plus coarse FOODON parent.'
  target_ids:

- assessment_id: case-004
  area: identity
  topic: Source-specific identity, supplied form and preparation boundary
  outcome: supported
  summary: The leading0.1% is the concentration of a resazurin preparation, not a

    with spelling/case/catalog-family qualifiers but no vitamin-depletion or concentration
    qualifier. Thermo primary guide distinguishes this amino-acid/peptide mixture
    from pancreatic tryptone and vitamin-assay material. Propose source-label additions
    to the ordinary owner; its shared FOODON parent must not collapse Casein peptone,
    and inherited carbocerate/metadata aliases need retirement before any whole-row
    release. No new CAS or molecular structure is inferred. The inherited Casamino
    Acids(0.01% fragment remains RAW_TEXT: prior#213 identified it as a truncated
    dose annotation, and this review lacks claim-specific evidence to reject it or
    reclassify it as a stock. Whole-row export review remains held. Independent review
    prompted exact ontology search: official active MeSH C017721 defines this acid
    hydrolysate, so the after proposal uses that exact material identity instead of
    registry plus coarse FOODON parent.'
